date.as_written: naipālikāvde vidhurandhrasiṃdhāvāṣāḍhaśukle pratipattithau ca [...] saṃ.791 āṣādḥa śudipādo aṃgāravārasa

notes: The chronogram vidhu-randhra-sindhu gives 1-9-7 (NS 791), which matches the numerical restatement saṃ 791. The scribe's name Śivahari is expressed poetically as śivādi-paścād-dhari ('having Śiva first and then Hari').
